headings.usage: Use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight) for large headings to create a heavy-weight, athletic feel. Do not use generic sans for headings.

body.usage: Use for all data tables, inputs, and dense UI components to ensure maximum legibility of financial and personal data.

colors.rules: Never use pure #000000 for surfaces. Always use slightly blue-tinted grays. Primary color is used sparingly for CTAs. Alerts use Electric Blaze.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Grid Borders (The Technical Look). Expose the skeleton. Data-heavy dashboards should use flat backgrounds with 1px subtle borders (border-white/10).
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal. Use 1px inner strokes instead of soft shadows to ground elements.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Only for sticky headers/navs: bg-black/60 with backdrop-blur-xl and border-b border-white/10.

layouts.dashboard_grid: High Density Grid (Mode B). grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 with gap-4 or gap-6. Every pixel must be utilized. Cards should stretch full height.
layouts.spacing: Generous spacing philosophy (p-6, p-8) for forms and isolated components, tight density for data tables.
layouts.alignment: Left-align dense content, forms, and tables. Optical alignment for icons.

component_rules.cards: Cardless or sharp rectangles. Flat background, 1px border, no shadow by default. Hover states lift slightly with border color change.
component_rules.forms: Use Shadcn components (Input, Select, Form). Inputs should have dark backgrounds with clear focus rings (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary).
component_rules.tables: Dense, highly scannable tables for 'Tesserati' and 'Movimenti'. Striped rows or clear hover states. Left align text, right align currency.
component_rules.buttons: Sharp corners or slight radius (rounded-md). High contrast text. Always define hover:bg and hover:text explicitly.
component_rules.modals: Backdrop blur on overlay. Sharp edges for the dialog window.

motion.interactions: Hover states on all interactive elements. Focus states for accessibility.
motion.transitions: Use specific properties (transition-colors, transition-transform) with duration-200. NO transition-all.
motion.loading: Use skeleton loaders for tables and charts.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 ratio for normal text.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case based on role (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button').
accessibility.focus: Clear focus rings on all inputs and buttons.

media.icons_library: Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) for a technical, high-end look suitable for dense dashboards.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the dashboard exclusively in Dark Mode to align with the Performance Pro archetype.
Implement role-based routing (Admin vs Technician) immediately after login.
For the 'Ricevute' PDF export, ensure it structurally mimics the 'Wolf's Mind ASD' receipt logic (unique numbering, tech distinct). Use a library like jspdf or react-pdf.
Use Shadcn UI components heavily but customize them to remove the 'default Vercel' look: use sharp corners, deep dark backgrounds, and subtle 1px white/10 borders.
Include data-testid attributes on EVERY interactive element (buttons, form inputs, table rows) to facilitate automated testing.
Ensure 'Scadenze' (deadlines for membership and medical visits) are prominently displayed using the accent_alert (#FF3B30) color.
Use Recharts or Shadcn Charts for the 'Report Bilancio' and Dashboard KPIs.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not use generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and surface elevation, not heavy shadows.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). Use targeted transitions.
You MUST NOT center align the app container in global CSS.
Use modern button styles (sharp or slightly rounded with interaction animations).
Never use AI assistant emoji characters (🤖🧠💡) for icons. Use the specified Phosphor Icons library.
Use sonner for toast notifications (located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx).
Use real Italian text for UI labels as requested in the problem statement.
